headword: {交感|こうかん}{神経|しんけい}

definitions.explanation: the part of the autonomic nervous system that activates the body's fight-or-flight response, increasing heart rate, blood pressure, and alertness

examples.japanese: ストレスで{交感|こうかん}{神経|しんけい}が{優位|ゆうい}になる。
examples.english: The sympathetic nervous system becomes dominant due to stress.

examples.japanese: {交感|こうかん}{神経|しんけい}が{活発|かっぱつ}になると{心拍数|しんぱくすう}が{上|あ}がる。
examples.english: When the sympathetic nervous system becomes active, the heart rate rises.

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}になっても{交感|こうかん}{神経|しんけい}が{高|たか}ぶったままだと、なかなか{眠|ねむ}れなくなる。
examples.english: If the sympathetic nervous system remains heightened at night, it becomes difficult to fall asleep.

notes:
Part of the {自律|じりつ}{神経|しんけい} (autonomic nervous system), responsible for the body's active, alert state. Composed of {交感|こうかん} (sympathetic, responsive) + {神経|しんけい} (nerve). Commonly discussed in health articles about stress, sleep, and relaxation techniques.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交感|こうかん}{神経|しんけい}が{優位|ゆうい}になる — the sympathetic nervous system becomes dominant
- {交感|こうかん}{神経|しんけい}が{活発|かっぱつ}になる — the sympathetic nervous system becomes active
- {交感|こうかん}{神経|しんけい}と{副交感|ふくこうかん}{神経|しんけい} — sympathetic and parasympathetic nerves
- {交感|こうかん}{神経|しんけい}の{興奮|こうふん} — sympathetic nerve excitation

THE AUTONOMIC NERVOUS SYSTEM:
- {自律|じりつ}{神経|しんけい} — autonomic nervous system (umbrella term)
- {交感|こうかん}{神経|しんけい} — sympathetic (fight-or-flight: accelerates heart, dilates pupils)
- {副交感|ふくこうかん}{神経|しんけい} — parasympathetic (rest-and-digest: slows heart, promotes digestion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {副交感|ふくこうかん}{神経|しんけい} — parasympathetic nerve (the complementary system for rest)
- {自律|じりつ}{神経|しんけい} — autonomic nervous system (includes both)
- {末梢|まっしょう}{神経|しんけい} — peripheral nerve
